description: This file defines the SobolEngine class for generating Sobol quasi-random sequences, including methods for drawing sequences, resetting, fast-forwarding, and scrambling the sequence generator.

classes.name: SobolEngine
classes.description: Engine for generating scrambled Sobol sequences, supporting sequence drawing, resetting, fast-forwarding, and scrambling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SobolEngine with specified dimension, scramble option, and seed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws a sequence of n points from the Sobol sequence.

methods.name: draw_base2
methods.description: Draws 2^m points from the Sobol sequence.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the SobolEngine to its base state.

methods.name: fast_forward
methods.description: Fast-forwards the sequence state by n steps.

methods.name: _scramble
methods.description: Applies scrambling to the Sobol sequence for better randomness.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SobolEngine instance.
